content: Top Reddit/review complaints about Strong and Hevy: (1) 'too many taps to log a set' — users want 2-3 seconds per set; (2) Strong free tier caps at 3 routines; (3) Hevy social features introduce complexity/bugs; (4) offline reliability matters — gym basements kill network-dependent apps; (5) Hevy's growing featureset slows down core logging path for power users. Logging speed is the primary retention driver — slow entry kills daily habit.
